item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"prompt_count","expression":"len(prompt)","rationale":"Captures per-string cleaning calls and list construction overhead."},{"name":"total_characters","expression":"sum(len(u) for u in prompt)","rationale":"Captures length-dependent scanning in text repair, HTML unescaping, and whitespace normalization."},{"name":"space_count","expression":"sum(u.count(' ') for u in prompt)","rationale":"Captures whitespace matches and substitutions for the supplied ASCII prompts."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is approximately linear in the number of prompts, total characters, and whitespace substitutions."}
